WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1999
)
SELECT 
    i_item_id,
    s_state,
    grouping(s_state) g_state,
    avg(ss_quantity) agg1,
    avg(ss_list_price) agg2,
    avg(ss_coupon_amt) agg3,
    avg(ss_sales_price) agg4
FROM 
    store_sales
JOIN 
    customer_demographics ON ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk AND cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
JOIN 
    filtered_date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
JOIN 
    store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND s_state = 'TN'
GROUP BY 
    GROUPING SETS ((i_item_id, s_state), (i_item_id), ())
ORDER BY 
    i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
